welcome:
Welcome to the Git CLI Playground.
Type commands to explore a simulated payment-service repository.
Type 'help' for available commands, 'scenario' for guided labs.

scenarios.title: Fix a Bad Merge with Bisect

steps.instruction: A regression broke the payment validation endpoint. Start by checking the recent commit history.
The bug was reported after the last release. Start a bisect session to find which commit introduced it.
Mark the current HEAD as bad — the bug exists here.
Tag v1.1.0 was the last known good release. Mark it as good.
Git has checked out a midpoint commit. Check which commit you are on.
After testing, this commit is good. Mark it.
Git narrows the range. After testing this one, it is the bad commit. Mark it.
Bisect found the offending commit. End the bisect session and return to your branch.

scenarios.title: Clean Up Feature Branch Before PR

steps.instruction: You are on feature/payments with messy commits. First check the branch status.
See how your branch diverges from main.
Fetch the latest changes from origin to make sure main is up to date.
Rebase your feature branch onto main to get a linear history.
Now squash your last 3 commits into one clean commit using interactive rebase.
Check the log to confirm your commits are squashed into one.
Amend the commit message to follow conventional commits.
Force-push the cleaned-up branch to origin safely.

commands.help:
Available commands:
  git status                     — working tree status
  git diff [options]             — show changes (--staged, --stat, HEAD~N)
  git log [options]              — commit history (--oneline, --graph, --author, -p)
  git branch [options]           — list, create, delete branches
  git checkout / git switch      — switch branches or restore files
  git merge [branch]             — merge a branch into current
  git rebase [branch]            — rebase current branch onto another
  git stash [subcommand]         — stash working changes
  git remote -v                  — list remotes
  git fetch / pull / push        — sync with remote
  git reset [options]            — undo commits (--soft, --hard)
  git revert HEAD                — create a revert commit
  git restore [file]             — discard working changes
  git bisect [subcommand]        — binary search for bad commit
  git reflog                     — reference log history
  git cherry-pick [hash]         — apply a commit from another branch
  git tag [options]              — manage tags
  git blame [file]               — line-by-line authorship
  git shortlog -sn               — contributor summary
  git config --list              — show configuration

  scenario                       — start a guided lab
  clear                          — clear the terminal
  help                           — show this help
